Model card: **Duo-1.0-distill-quant** **A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction** Model Overview Duo is a full-duplex multimodal world model for real-time audio-visual interaction. This repository contains the FP8-quantized four-step distilled Realization weights for Duo 1.0. | Field | Value | | --- | --- | | Version | Duo 1.0 | | Variant | FP8-quantized four-step distilled Realization | | Package | Realization overlay | | Realization format | ModelOpt FP8, per-channel scaling | | Base dependency | | | Default sampler | Euler, 4 steps, flow shift 5.0 | Usage Download the complete Duo 1.0 causal-base bundle, then overlay these Realization weights into the same directory: The shared Intent, codecs, speech models, and Realization backbone are supplied by the causal-base bundle. The consuming runtime must support the packaged ModelOpt FP8 format or an equivalent conversion path. For code, configuration, and runtime-specific integration instructions, see inclusionAI/Duo. License These weights were initialized from MiniMax H3 and subsequently trained by the Duo team. See LICENSE and NOTICE for the applicable terms.
